items.title: 建立流程事实 L0-L4 分级 registry
items.context: 把流程事实命令的硬度、owner、说明和消费方式集中在代码级配置里，作为 prompt、runtime、contract test 的单一事实源。
items.userSees: `npm run test:process-fact-contract` 输出 Process Fact Level Registry，并列出 CLI commands classified by L0-L4；维护者能看到 story_advance 是 L4，而 status/session_brief 是 L0。

happy.desc: registry 覆盖 MAIN_TOOLS 全命令，每条都有 command/level/category/owner/rationale。

edge.desc: L0 命令可以存在，但候选流程事实命令不能标成 L0。

adversarial.desc: 新增 surprise_check_set 但未登记时 contract test 明确失败。

verificationEvidence.note: contract test reads process-fact-levels registry and reports 87 entries covering 84 CLI commands plus runtime behaviors.
contract asserts process-fact candidate commands cannot be L0 while ordinary read/status commands may remain L0.
synthetic surprise_check_set remains detected as missing when not registered in the process fact level registry.

items.title: 让 process fact contract test 消费 registry
items.context: 现有 scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs 维护了独立 inventory，应改为读取 registry，并继续覆盖 pass-only finding_add、legacy category、prompt drift 和新增流程事实命令未登记。
items.userSees: `npm run test:process-fact-contract` 不再维护脚本内 processFactCliInventory；它从 process-fact-levels registry 读取命令，打印 registry entry 数，并继续通过 pass-only/legacy/prompt-drift synthetic checks。

happy.desc: contract test 从 registry 读取命令覆盖，而不是脚本内独立 inventory。

edge.desc: prompt drift、pass-only finding_add、legacy/unknown category 检查保持有效。

adversarial.desc: registry 缺命令或重复命令时 contract test 失败。

verificationEvidence.note: script no longer uses a local processFactCliInventory set; command coverage comes from the registry parser.
existing prompt drift, pass-only finding_add, legacy category, and unknown category synthetic checks still pass.
contract fails missing or duplicate registry command entries and validates MAIN_TOOLS coverage from registry.

items.title: 补齐边缘执行语义的硬化覆盖
items.context: 把 phaseTools 配置异常、test_auto 递归跳过、validate fallback 这类软点至少登记为分级事实并用测试说明其硬度边界，避免误以为它们是 gate 级别。
items.userSees: contract 输出包含精确行："- runtime:phase_tools_malformed_allow_all [L1] owner=core/config"、"- runtime:test_auto_recursive_skip [L2] owner=handlers/test-auto"、"- runtime:validate_fallback_discovery [L1] owner=handlers/verifier"。

happy.desc: 边缘执行语义作为 named entries 出现在 registry 并有明确 level/rationale。

edge.desc: registry 能表达非 CLI 命令的 runtime behavior entry，不要求它出现在 MAIN_TOOLS。

adversarial.desc: L4 entry 必须声明 gateConsumer，避免把软 fallback 误标为硬 gate。

verificationEvidence.note: contract output includes runtime:phase_tools_malformed_allow_all, runtime:test_auto_recursive_skip, and runtime:validate_fallback_discovery entries.
registry accepts runtime-prefixed behavior entries while requiring non-runtime entries to match MAIN_TOOLS.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:process-fact-contract && npm run build
verificationEvidence.note: contract asserts every L4 registry entry declares gateConsumer, so soft fallback entries cannot masquerade as gate facts.
